name: Orange♥Honey ~Boku wa Kimi ni Koishiteru~
original_name: オレンジ♥ハニー ～僕はキミに恋してる～
source:
The heroine, Kaze Aiha, is facing a crisis in her life.

After a certain incident, she suddenly isn’t able to paint even though she’s an award-winning member of the art club.

Unable to handle the pressure, she decides to quit the club while using her student council duties as an excuse.

Oh, will she ever be able to paint again…?

[taken from [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/08/26/otome-game-review-orange-honey-boku-wa-kimi-ni-koishiteru-by-marvelous-interactive/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
女主角加濑爱叶正面临人生危机。

她原本是屡获奖项的美术社成员，某件事后却突然再也画不出画。

无法承受压力的她以学生会工作为借口，决定退出社团。

唉，她还能再次拿起画笔吗……？

[译自 [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/08/26/otome-game-review-orange-honey-boku-wa-kimi-ni-koishiteru-by-marvelous-interactive/]Koorin的博客[/url]]
